newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends higher on CBOT spillover.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends higher on CBOT spillover.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended higher amid slim volumes on local buying tied to spillover support from CBOT wheat, traders said.
"It was pretty featureless trade. We were up basically in sympathy with Chicago," a trader said.
CBOT wheat rallied in late midsession dealings on short covering linked to signals the market was oversold, traders there said.
The Minneapolis Grain Exchange estimated Monday's spring wheat volume at 12.914 million bushels, down from 14.27 million bushels on Friday.
MGE spring wheat closed two to five cents per bushel higher, with Dec up five cents at $4.12-3/4.
Benson Quinn reportedly bought 600,000 Dec and 600,000 March bushels. Atwood-Peavey bought 700,000 Dec and LFG sold 800,000 Dec, traders said.
MGE Dec barley closed five cents per hundredweight lower at $7.19. MGE March barley gained five cents to close at $7.21. No other barley delivery months traded.
